title: T7 Prior-Artifact / Native Survival Output Resolution
purpose: Resolve the actual T7 artifact inventory and candidate native survival-output structures before empirical evaluation.

semantic_restrictions: event=0 must not be relabelled as a negative resolution outcome.
T7 must not be converted into ordinary binary resolved/not-resolved confidence.
Calibration must be defined for an appropriate survival/time-to-event predictive quantity.
boundary.calibration_boundary: Later T7 calibration must retain survival semantics and right censoring.

T7_binary_conversion_prohibited.basis: The frozen T7 boundary is ACCEPTED_NATIVE_SURVIVAL. This operation does not require or infer a native_probability_output field. Binary conversion is prohibited by the T7 survival/censoring boundary itself.

interpretation.operation_role: Read-only structural and semantic candidate resolution.
interpretation.next_operation: OP-013B should resolve the actual T7 event, censoring, duration/time, and native survival-output semantics from the strongest candidate artifact(s).

methodological_restrictions: No target creation or relabelling is permitted.
Survival outputs must not be converted into an ordinary binary resolution target.
Filename or field-name discovery alone does not establish survival semantics.
No final T7 artifact is selected solely from heuristic filename scoring.
No locked test data are used for method or artifact selection.
